coverage_gaps: Embase and other non-PubMed bibliographic indexes are unavailable, so conference abstracts and differently indexed studies may be missed.
Citation-graph and DOI metadata services are unavailable, limiting systematic forward- and backward-citation expansion beyond PubMed-linked records.
Non-US regulatory sources are unavailable, so EMA, MHRA, Health Canada, and other jurisdictional actions cannot be compared directly with FDA actions.
Preprint servers are unavailable, so recent unreviewed findings cannot be systematically checked through the cutoff.
Patient-level trial data, sponsor clinical study reports, insurance claims, electronic health records, and spontaneous-reporting analytic datasets are unavailable for independent reanalysis.
Full-text availability is not guaranteed by the supplied routes, which may limit verification of subgroup definitions, absolute event counts, adjudication methods, and nuanced correction effects.
exclusion_criteria: Records first made available after 2024-12-31, while retaining later notices only in a separately flagged future update.
Non-rheumatoid-arthritis evidence unless it directly underlies an FDA action affecting marketed rheumatoid arthritis use or provides an explicitly applicable class-safety qualifier.
Animal, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, and mechanism-only studies without decision-relevant clinical safety outcomes.
Efficacy-only reports that provide no cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, serious-adverse-event, or regulatory evidence.
Narrative commentary, news coverage, promotional material, and unsupported opinion lacking traceable primary evidence or regulatory documentation.
Duplicate manifestations of the same record after identifiers are merged; preserve every query-to-record link and retain the most complete version rather than double counting.
Reports with irreconcilable study identity, population, dose, comparator, or outcome data until the conflict is resolved or the record is explicitly quarantined.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, correction, and FDA effective dates recorded separately.
Human rheumatoid arthritis evidence evaluating marketed tofacitinib exposure or an FDA action directly affecting its rheumatoid arthritis use.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its full version history available through the cutoff, and publications linked by registry identifier, study name, design, population, or sponsor metadata.
Primary randomized evidence and prespecified or clearly labeled post hoc analyses reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcomes.
FDA safety communications, multidisciplinary reviews, approval or postmarketing documents, boxed warnings, and prescribing-information revisions that identify jurisdiction and action date.
Comparative observational studies, registries, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses that can qualify, reproduce, or conflict with pivotal-study findings.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, and linked publication notices for included evidence.
Any language when sufficient English metadata or translatable content supports reliable eligibility and extraction.

queries.purpose: Recover the named pivotal postauthorization study and candidate primary or linked publications while validating the study name and registry identifier.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover the anchor registry record and capture sponsor, design, enrollment, doses, comparator, outcome definitions, results, linked publications, and update history.
Recover FDA materials that explicitly connect the pivotal safety study to regulatory review or action.
queries.query: tofacitinib AND ("ORAL Surveillance" OR NCT02092467 OR "postmarketing safety trial")

queries.purpose: Discover high-recall human rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across every decision-relevant outcome domain through the cutoff.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify registered rheumatoid arthritis trials that can qualify the anchor study, reveal related safety results, or expose unpublished and ongoing evidence.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch]"Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch](tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (safety OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR thromboembolism OR mortality OR death)

queries.purpose: Discover FDA safety communications, reviews, labels, boxed warnings, and class-wide actions relevant to marketed rheumatoid arthritis use.
queries.query: (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (rheumatoid arthritis OR JAK inhibitor) AND (cardiovascular OR cancer OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR pulmonary embolism OR mortality OR death OR safety)

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary comparative publication and its cardiovascular and malignancy findings against the registry anchor.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND ("tumor necrosis factor inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR "TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis and mortality findings, including dose-specific and cause-specific analyses linked to the pivotal study.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Check the anchor record's results, adverse-event tables, linked publications, and version history for changes available by the cutoff.
queries.query: NCT02092467 AND (Results OR Outcome Measures OR Adverse Events OR History OR Publications)

queries.purpose: Reconstruct the dated FDA action sequence and verify how study findings changed warnings, labeling, indications, or recommended use.
queries.query: (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (2019 OR 2021 OR 2022 OR 2023 OR 2024) AND ("Drug Safety Communication" OR "boxed warning" OR label OR "prescribing information" OR restriction) AND (cardiovascular OR cancer OR thrombosis OR death)

queries.purpose: Expand from the anchor identifier and study name to linked secondary analyses that may qualify population, dose, timing, or outcome interpretation.
queries.query: (NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker*[Title/Abstract] OR infection*[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find comparative real-world and synthesized evidence that may support, narrow, or conflict with the pivotal trial findings.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR adalimumab[Title/Abstract] OR etanercept[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Actively seek null, conflicting, replication, bias, and confounding evidence relevant to causal and generalizability judgments.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND ("no increased risk"[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR inconsistent[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract] OR confounding[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify correction, erratum, retraction, or expression-of-concern records that change evidence handling or invalidate extracted values.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title])) OR (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type]))

queries.purpose: Capture later analyses, replications, critiques, and record-status notices published after the primary study through the delivery cutoff.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title]) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Verify whether FDA labeling or safety actions were revised after the pivotal action sequence and remained effective by the cutoff.
queries.query: (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (updated label OR prescribing information OR safety communication OR boxed warning OR postmarketing requirement) AND (2022 OR 2023 OR 2024)

question_frame: Safety PECO as of 2024-12-31: adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, with explicit attention to the cardiovascular-risk-enriched population in the pivotal postauthorization study; exposure to approved and studied tofacitinib doses; comparator of tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other relevant rheumatoid arthritis therapies; outcomes of major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, all-cause and cause-specific mortality, and treatment discontinuation. Identify and link the pivotal study registry record, primary publication, subsequent analyses, and FDA actions; evaluate effect estimates, population and dose qualifiers, concordant or conflicting evidence, and corrections, retractions, expressions of concern, or other record-status changes. Include human evidence in any language when sufficient English metadata or translatable content permits assessment, from database inception through the as_of date.
stop_rules: Do not exceed 16 query events; if the limit is reached, stop retrieval and report every unresolved evidence domain or source limitation.
Complete all planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update events across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory.
Require recovery and identity linkage of the pivotal registry record, its primary publication, and dated FDA actions before declaring anchor coverage complete.
Require extractable evidence for cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality outcomes; if a domain remains empty after its focused query and expansion, record it as a coverage gap.
Complete explicit correction, erratum, retraction, expression-of-concern, null-result, and conflicting-evidence checks before synthesis.
Stop expansion after two consecutive linked-record passes add no new decision-relevant eligible evidence, provided all anchor and outcome checks are complete.
Stop temporal updating only after each selected route has been checked through 2024-12-31 or its latest available record version before that date.
Merge by PMID, DOI, NCT identifier, FDA document identity, and study fingerprint while preserving all query-to-record occurrence links; unresolved conflicting duplicates fail closed.
If further retrieval within available routes cannot change the safety conclusion or its confidence after all mandatory checks, stop and document the remaining uncertainty.
